# Vendor graphics (Vecteezy / Freepik)

Drop **downloaded SVG files** here. Filenames must match `sources.json` → `layers.*.file`:

| File | Layer |
|------|--------|
| `backdrop.svg` | Backdrop |
| `floor.svg` | Stage floor |
| `amp-stack.svg` | PA stacks (L/R; right side is CSS-flipped) |
| `drums.svg` | Drum kit |
| `keys.svg` | Keys |
| `bass.svg` | Bass rig |
| `guitar.svg` | Guitarist |
| `vocal.svg` | Lead vocal |
| `lights.svg` | Lighting truss |
| `cables.svg` | Cable snakes |
| `crowd.svg` | Audience |
| `hall.svg` | Hall frame |
| `full-band.svg` | *(optional)* Full ensemble |

**Sources:** see [`../sources.json`](../sources.json) and [`../ATTRIBUTION.md`](../ATTRIBUTION.md).

**Import helper:** `../../../../scripts/import-stage-graphics.sh ~/Downloads`

This folder is intentionally empty in git (placeholders live in `../`).
